claims.statement: The LangChain documentation operates three content branches: (1) OSS versioned content (LangChain, LangGraph, most Deep Agents) builds to separate /oss/python/... and /oss/javascript/... URLs; (2) OSS language-agnostic content (/src/oss/openwiki/ and /src/oss/deepagents/code/) builds to single unversioned URLs; (3) LangSmith unversioned content (/src/langsmith/) builds to /langsmith/... URLs, except Managed Deep Agents which branch into language routes.

OSS versioned pages use a single source file with conditional language blocks (:::python and :::js fences) that generate separate Python and JavaScript build artifacts with language-specific links rewritten automatically during preprocessing.

Deep Agents Code (/src/oss/deepagents/code/) and OpenWiki (/src/oss/openwiki/) bypass language versioning and build once to single unversioned URLs without duplication, with conditional blocks resolving against the Python branch.

`src/docs.json` is the authoritative navigation and route configuration. Its current `navigation.products[]` entries contain `menu[]` items, whose route-bearing structures may be direct `pages`, `tabs`, or—for Build—`dropdowns[]` containing `tabs[]`; nested `pages` arrays hold route strings and group objects.

The preferred page-move invocation is `uv run docs mv <old-path> <new-path>`: the installed `docs` console script routes to `pipeline.cli:main`, whose mover rewrites matching relative and site-absolute links in Markdown, MDX, and notebook Markdown cells, and rewrites existing `docs.json` navigation values and redirect destinations while leaving redirect sources unchanged. It does not create redirects, so compatibility redirects remain manual work.

When linking to OpenWiki or Deep Agents Code unversioned pages from versioned OSS content, use unprefixed URLs (/oss/openwiki/... and /oss/deepagents/code/...) that are not rewritten to language-specific variants; the build system skips link versioning for language-agnostic products.

The `make broken-links` command builds the documentation, asks Mint to check redirects as well as links, and filters expected reports from deployment-time OpenAPI pages and standalone snippet files before failing on remaining broken-link output.

The removed-pages checker validates only navigation shapes it explicitly traverses—direct product pages, legacy tabs, dropdown tabs, and groups—and does not descend through the current `navigation.products[].menu[]` layer. Its redirect comparison therefore cannot establish source existence or redirect coverage for current menu-contained routes.

The builder rebuilds from src into a cleared build directory, and make dev performs an initial build before watching src and running mint dev from build; generated files are therefore validation output rather than an editable source of truth.

Direct `src/langsmith/managed-deep-agents*.mdx` pages are excluded from ordinary LangSmith output and emitted for both Python and JavaScript routes; `docs.json` supplies redirects from unversioned Managed Deep Agents URLs to a Python route.

Integration component table snippets are generated from hosted integration-guide frontmatter plus external discovery records; external records link through their `docs_url`, and the refresh script rejects unsafe URL schemes before rendering rows.

Repository authoring guidance treats `src/` as the manual-content surface, requires a `src/docs.json` update when adding a page, prohibits editing `build/`, and forbids Markdown in a frontmatter `description`.

Testable code samples are authored in `src/code-samples/`; `make code-snippets` extracts and generates derivative files under `src/code-samples-generated/` and `src/snippets/code-samples/`, so generated sample artifacts must be regenerated rather than hand-edited.
The `make lint_prose` target installs the pinned Vale binary and lints specified `FILES` or all of `src/`, while `make check-cross-refs` independently validates source `@[ref]` references.

The `docs` CLI exposes a dry-run move mode that previews link and in-file relative-link changes without moving or rewriting files; a non-dry run appends the move to `link_changes.jsonl` before relocating the source and updating its internal links.

The LangSmith OpenAPI processor fetches its default input only from allow-listed `api.smith.langchain.com`, then hides selected operations, normalizes operation titles, assigns and orders sidebar tag groups, and writes the transformed specification only when invoked with `--write`.
`make check-openapi` builds the documentation and currently runs `mint openapi-check` only on `langsmith/agent-server-openapi.json` from the build directory.

Reusable documentation blocks belong in `src/snippets/` and must be imported with `from '/snippets/...'`; this import form is the one the builder rewrites into language-specific snippet paths, unlike Mintlify's `<Snippet file="..." />` form.

For language-targeted builds, the builder rewrites root-relative `/langsmith/managed-deep-agents...` links to `/langsmith/python/...` or `/langsmith/javascript/...`, so source links can remain unversioned while emitted content follows its language route.

`bind-evaluator-to-dataset-link.mdx` is a navigation wrapper whose `url` points to the canonical `bind-evaluator-to-dataset` route; the current navigation exposes the wrapper in Experiment configuration and the canonical page in Experiment configuration and the canonical page in the Evaluators tab.

OpenAPI group entries in `docs.json` configure Mintlify-generated endpoint directories. The committed Agent Server and LangSmith REST specifications have explicit directories, while the Control Plane source is fetched from a remote URL at deployment; the generated endpoint pages are absent from local build output.

The code-snippet extractor accepts language-specific `:snippet-start:` and `:snippet-end:` markers, removes `:remove-start:` regions from the displayed body, and fails when a snippet or remove region is unclosed; the Make target then runs extraction before MDX generation.
The Makefile's `test` target passes `TEST_FILE` to pytest, so a focused unit suite can be run as `make test TEST_FILE=<test-path>`.

Workflow-owned documentation outputs include the weekly LangSmith and Fleet changelogs, the self-hosted changelog, and the LangSmith platform and Agent Server OpenAPI specifications; contributors must correct their upstream input or owner rather than hand-editing those files.

Changing a heading can change its public fragment slug; authoring guidance directs contributors to search inbound anchors first, while capitalization-only changes are safe because slugs are lowercased and components can retain a target through an explicit `id`.

The current agent procedures assign page lifecycle, navigation, redirects, and verification to `add-docs-page`; for edits on an existing PR, `docs-edit` requires using the PR head branch and verifying factual claims against owning sources rather than sibling documentation.

The page-add procedure directs contributors to run the `docs-review` skill after finished prose edits, but to skip it for a change too small to contain prose, such as a navigation reorder or redirect-only fix.
